name: Anduke
source:
Born of a human and a Elyos, he is the only person on earth of Elyos descent. Even though he has a violent personality and is uncooperative, the fate of the world rests on Anduke shoulders. He is the ultra-villainous hero.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071230090604fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/dangel/chara.html]Mink[/url]]
